issues.classification: underspecified ambient carrier in closure lemma
issues.finding: The lemma quantifies ‘any function f and any o in A’ without introducing A, and its witness ran(f) union {o} is automatically f-closed only when the function is understood on an invariant ambient carrier containing o.
issues.action: Preserved the displayed statement and proof because all later applications explicitly use endofunctions g:D→D or f:A→A; recorded the hidden carrier assumption for expert review rather than inventing a formal repair.
alternatives: Define f-closed only for subsets of dom(f)
issues.uncertainty: The intended endofunction reading is clear from later applications, but the most faithful global repair depends on the surrounding formal convention for partial application.
issues.review_question: Should the lemma explicitly quantify an endofunction f:A→A and o∈A, and should its closure definition be restricted to subsets of A?
issues.required_translation_handling: Preserve formulas and disclose the ambient-carrier assumption until an authoritative source repair is adopted.
